chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, raising it from Al-Reza (peace be upon him), said:
The Imam bears the imaginations (of the followers) of those behind him, except for the opening Takbir.

key_terms.أَوْهَامَ: Imaginations (plural of wahm, referring to mental states or specific recitations in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the exception to the Imam carrying the imaginations of the followers during prayer?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Rida (AS), the concept of the Imam 'carrying the errors' (wahm) of the congregation is clarified to exclude the opening Takbir, which must be individually performed by each worshipper. This distinction highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that while the Imam's validity generally covers the followers' actions, certain foundational acts like the initial Takbir require personal intention and execution, ensuring the prayer's structural integrity.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, 
(It has been narrated) raising it from Al-Reza<sup>as
ws having said: ‘The prayer leader would bear the imaginations of the ones behind him except for the opening Takbīr’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya in a marfu‘ manner has narrated from the following: “Al-Rida, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
An Imam carries and sustains the conjectures of those who are behind him except the opening Takbir (Allah is great beyond description).”’
